title: A spool for every quotient: One-loop partition functions in AdS3 gravity
abstract: One-loop partition functions in AdS3 gravity via a worldline / heat-kernel 'spool' construction over quotients of hyperbolic space. NOTE: 2025 paper, catalogued as a REFERENCE, not a scan-window headline.
key_claims: The right tool IF the worldline/MERA correspondence (m_eff, F(dr)) is pushed from boundary-correlator to genuine bulk-worldline computation.
